This distribution includes unmodified OpenSSL libraries supplied by the
Windows CPython 3.11.7 runtime, reporting OpenSSL 3.0.11 (19 September 2023).

The libraries are licensed under Apache License 2.0; the complete official
license text is retained in LICENSE.txt. AUTHORS.md preserves the upstream
authorship list from the exact openssl-3.0.11 source tag.

Source: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/tree/openssl-3.0.11
Windows build material: https://github.com/python/cpython-bin-deps/tree/openssl-bin-3.0.11
